miniResult.headline: You are a True Summer
miniResult.summary: Your cool rosy skin and blue eyes reflect the serene and balanced tones of True Summer. Soft periwinkles and gentle greys naturally enliven your complexion. Embracing these shades will make your features come alive with clarity and harmony.
miniResult.imagePrompt: editorial portrait of the person draped in Rose Mauve, Soft Navy, and Lavender Blue, confident pose. High-end editorial fashion photography, natural lighting, professional.

contrast.explanation: We detected a balanced medium contrast between your cool brown hair and rosy skin. This harmony sets the stage for medium-contrast clothing which supports your natural features without overwhelming them. By using this level of contrast in your outfits, your face stays the primary focus. If you've noticed that very high-contrast pairings like black and white feel severe, this is why.

finalLook.description: Wearing Rose Mauve encourages a serene softness, making your skin appear more even and alive, and your blue eyes become a focal point of depth and clarity. The color seamlessly integrates into your natural palette, enhancing rather than overshadowing your innate beauty.

families.comment: Warm shades can introduce an uncomfortable warmth against your cool rosy skin, making it appear flushed and slightly overdone. Colors like orange and peach will clash with your skin's innate clarity, drawing eyes away from your face's harmonious balance.

Cool tones in blues, pinks, and muted greens resonate deeply with your natural complexion. These shades flatter by echoing your skin's rosy undertone and brightening your blue eyes, providing a serene contrast that heightens your overall elegance.

Bright colors occasionally overpower your medium depth and contrast, pushing your natural features into the background. These shades can dominate rather than elevate your inherent softness, reducing the natural harmony you carry.

Muted tones support the natural clarity of your skin and eyes, lending a subtle and seamless transition across your features. These colors integrate effortlessly, offering a backdrop that enhances your gentle depth and natural beauty.

Light shades like soft blues and gentle pinks mirror the natural lightness in your rosy skin. These colors lift shadows and provide a refreshing balance, offering an airy, bright impression to your features.

Deep tones can occasionally weigh down your complexion, competing with your face's natural contrast levels. They define more than enhance, which can lead to an overly stark appearance, pulling attention away from your face.

faceArchetype.tagline: Your facial features align most closely with the Classic aesthetic.
faceArchetype.reason: Your oval face shape and defined jaw create a harmonious balance that epitomizes the Classic aesthetic. Medium feature scale combined with cool undertones allows your natural symmetry to shine, perfectly matching this clean yet elegant style. Your almond eye shape adds to the refined, timeless essence that defines the Classic approach.

stylingNotes.hair: Classic styles with soft layers align well with medium wavy hair, maintaining elegance and natural movement.
stylingNotes.glasses: Medium-sized frames in cool shades ensure your natural symmetry is the focal point.
stylingNotes.accessories: Choose medium-scale accessories in timeless shapes that adhere to your classic aesthetic.
stylingNotes.makeup: Soft yet defined looks—thin eyeliner with cool pink tones accentuate almond eyes.
stylingNotes.outfits: Opt for tailored silhouettes that emphasize your symmetrical shape; avoid overly rigid styles.

signatureSummary.colors: cool blues, greys, and rosy pinks
signatureSummary.makeup: cool pink blush, rose mauve lips
signatureSummary.glasses: oval or soft rectangular, cool grey
signatureSummary.summary: Your best look isn't built around trends — it's built around harmony. When your colours, hair, jewellery, and makeup all follow the same visual language, your features naturally become the centre of attention: brighter, more defined, and effortlessly polished. Instead of people noticing your outfit first, they notice you.

best.reason: Silver resonates with your cool coloring, drawing out the serene hues in your overall palette.
White Gold offers a refined complement to your True Summer depth, less stark than silver yet seamlessly integrated.

avoid.reason: Yellow Gold introduces a warm note discordant with your cool tones, clashing visibly at the neckline.

metals.explanation: Cool metals align with your True Summer palette, enhancing harmony and refinement.
